## Goal
Add eval coverage proving Open Brain works as an agent memory substrate across compaction, privacy, receipts, and recall.

## Scope
- Add fixtures for local Codex compact/wrap recovery.
- Add privacy fixture proving private lane data does not enter shared-kb.
- Add receipt fixture proving a report/document can cite input files, base template/PDF, output artifact, and validations.
- Add recall fixture for names, repos, dates/times, channels, files, and linked graph entities.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Eval suite fails when key lifecycle facts are missing after compaction.
- Eval suite fails when private data is promoted or receipts are incomplete.
- Results are documented in the plan or PR validation.
